documented_impact: Housing disruption and displacement into temporary accommodation, with gaps in basic and protection services.
fcv_mediator: Unequal access and pre-existing gender/disability vulnerability in displacement settings.
possible_consequence: The response plan identifies heightened protection risks and calls for violence-prevention and inclusive access; it does not estimate actual new violence.
alternative_explanations: Pre-existing exclusion, accommodation design and service availability shape risk independently of hazard severity.
uncertainty: Historical needs assessment and prospective protection-risk mechanism, not a reported violence rate or climate-attribution estimate. Not independently reverified in the 27 October 2026 remediation; check the cited passage before relying on this claim.
resilience_factors: The plan prioritizes accessible services and protection referral; delivery and effectiveness are not established.
compact_statement: The 2024 Nepal flood plan identifies protection risks where displacement meets service gaps and unequal access, without measuring new violence.
